fact: The Ombudsman, having inspected forty LMPS stations and posts nationwide between May and September 2023, reports that computers and internet facilities were non-existent in most stations and posts and that a huge number had no electricity, and records at individual stations that there were no computers, paperwork and filing were done manually and information was stored manually.
title: Ombudsman's Report on the Inspection of Police Cells Nationwide 2023
